Game Overview

In Charge, the core idea is straightforward: catch and conquer in Charge, a vibrant arcade challenge testing your reflexes. Spin your battery swiftly to align with falling charges, gathering them accurately for high scores. With escalating speed and eye-catching visuals, Charge offers a dynamic and thrilling adventure for players of all ages.
